2032.name: Standing Forward Fold with Arm Extension (Uttanasana Variation)
2032.current_description:
1. Stand tall on your mat with feet hip-width apart, weight evenly distributed.
2. Take a deep breath in, then exhale as you hinge forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
3. Fold your torso down toward your thighs, letting your head hang heavy and relaxed.
4. Once in the forward fold, extend one arm straight back and up toward the ceiling, rotating through your upper spine.
5. Keep your standing legs engaged (you can have a soft bend in the knees if needed for comfort).
6. Hold for 3–5 breaths, feeling the stretch through your hamstrings, lower back, and the opened side of your chest and shoulder.
7. Slowly lower your arm, then repeat on the other side.
